MOHD HAMMAD KHAN P G D M S t u d e n t Self driven and result oriented PGDM student with a hunger to learn new things and a strong work ethic with a positive work attitude. Eager to leverage my conceptual skills and business acumen to make a significant contribution to a dynamic organization

Internship

Conducted comprehensive financial analysis of companies to support strategic investment decisions. Gained hands-on experience in both fundamental and technical analysis for effective valuation. Researched market trends and industry developments in the FMCG sector; performed backtesting to identify the most effective technical indicators tailored to the sector. Contributed to investment strategies by identifying and evaluating high-potential opportunities aligned with client and organizational goals. Assessed client-specific risk profiles by analyzing financial goals, risk tolerance, and investment objectives to support personalized investment recommendations. Collaborated in a cross-functional team of four on a live risk assessment project aimed at enhancing customer experience and offering optimized investment solutions.

Academic Projects Undertaken

Live Project | CavinKare | The Live Sales and Distribution Project | 2024 – Surveyed different shops in Bangalore to check the product availability in the retail and wholesale stores and gathered insights from shop owners about the services provided for better relationship management and improve the growth of the company. Market Research Paper on Awareness of Green Finance Options for Small businesses in Bangalore presented at BITS Pilani, Rajasthan. Equity Research: Assessing Mahindra Logistics as a Strategic Investment Partner for HDFC Life in this analyzed companies past performance, current market performance and current strategic partners for better performance. The Role of Nostalgia in the Resurgence of Penmanship in Bengaluru | Market Research Paper |2023-24

Academics & Rewards

“Atal Bihari Vajpayee Memorial Scholarship” Rs. 50,000 |2023

Extra-Curricular Activities

Participated in UNMAD IIM Bangalore for Just a Minute Vertical involving quick thinking and public speaking| 2024 Winner in Dodgeball Burning Bush, College Sports and Management Fest| 2024 Legal Aid Camp organized by Faculty of law, Integral University | 2021
